spec: ISA0.9 §3.3 legal qjumpr widths; §11.1 independent A/P formals and ref-0.9-r1 catalog
derivation: For n=3 the shared pc width P=2 coexists with source address widths A=3 and A=4. Full-A-bit comparisons detect high out-of-range bits; only min(A,P) low bits enter succ. A=2,P=4 also leaves high successor bits zero. Exhaustive small address domains, enabled/disabled controls, arbitrary code/faulted and successor targets reverse exactly.
